newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Denmark sees heavy loss under new market rule.
newsitem.headline: Tele Denmark sees heavy loss under new market rule.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Denmark said on Monday that it could lose 1.2-1.9 billion crowns a year due to new market regulations in Denmark.
The former monopoly operator, Tele Danmark, said final legislation deregulating the telecommunications industry that is due this spring, will cut earnings.
The government plans to price-cap interconnect deals that will have an adverse impact, the company said.

"Reduction of interconnect prices in the period to the year 2001 will cause an annual pre-tax loss of 0.5-1.0 billion crowns on the fixed network and 0.7-0.9 billion crowns on the cellular network," the company said in a statement.
